intent_contract.text: Repeat the parent arm-E municipal celestial-survey photograph as a controlled lineage-bound ablation. Preserve the parent concept, adult subject, visible event, and facial-outline appearance obligation while changing only reference_use so generation receives no image input.

Create a documentary photograph of an unmistakably adult woman, a survey astronomer on a municipal observatory rooftop at dawn. Treat her as an original adult subject created directly from the written scene. In a chest-up, nearly frontal portrait, she draws an azimuth line from a brass transit telescope toward the bright morning star while steadying a transparent city-map overlay across a weathered atlas; a mechanical chronometer, compass, penciled coordinate grid, and wind-lifted survey sheets keep the task readable. Her expression is calm and neutral, all hair is pinned away from both temples, cheekbones, jaw corners, and chin, and the complete hairline temple cheek jaw and chin perimeter remains visible. Across that outline, the upper and middle face are moderately longer than wide; the cheek region is wider than the jaw; the jaw narrows more strongly and smoothly into a small chin with a softly rounded tip. Here literal contour evidence replaces the culture-scoped label at runtime. Use distortion-controlled portrait perspective, balanced bilateral outline visibility, and soft side-to-front dawn light that models every facial landmark.

The contradiction appears at the deliberately selected reveal strength, immediate or delayed, while remaining clearly authored, subordinate to one inferable world rule, and distinguishable from generic image failure.

In one still, keep a calm low-expression baseline visibly stable while one concrete, quiet practical action helps one identifiable trusted adult counterpart and leaves an already-visible helpful consequence for that same counterpart. Add only one localized warmth leak, such as slight lower-lid easing, a restrained brow release, a fractional mouth-corner softening, or reduced tension in the hand or shoulder nearest the target. Optional outward support may use economical gesture, stable upright posture, a neat simple silhouette, restrained grooming, or a muted/cool-neutral palette, but these are conventions rather than requirements. Do not assign fixed hair color, eye color, hairstyle, costume, gender, occupation, gaze direction, camera angle, or prop, and do not let expressionlessness, competence, beauty, a cool palette, or a caring object substitute for the same-target action and consequence. Preserve the counterpart's autonomy; avoid hostile denial, shy withdrawal, possessive control, broad open affection, or an abrupt personality switch.
